title: Insurance Claims and Service Advisor
description:
Claims & Service Adviser
Shoeburyness, Essex £26,000-£28,000, with flexibility for the right experience Full-time, office-based

Do you have insurance claims or customer service experience and enjoy helping customers, solving problems and seeing cases through to resolution?

CKB Recruitment is working with an established insurance business to recruit a Claims & Service Adviser for its team in Shoeburyness.

Covering gadget insurance, travel insurance and ticket protection, this varied role will give you the opportunity to broaden your knowledge across several products. You'll handle claims, sales enquiries, policy servicing and first-line complaints, taking ownership and working closely with colleagues to deliver a positive customer experience.

You'll join an open, collaborative business where people are encouraged to share ideas, ask questions and help improve how things are done.

The salary, benefits and working environment
- £26,000-£28,000 basic salary, depending on experience, with a higher salary potentially available for the right candidate, particularly someone with closely relevant insurance experience.
- 22 days' annual leave plus bank holidays.
- The opportunity to earn up to three additional days' holiday through the company's non-sickness policy.
- The opportunity to earn up to three further days' holiday through length of service.
- A welcoming, open-plan office with fresh fruit, biscuits and snacks provided weekly, plus a new coffee machine.
- Opportunities to develop your knowledge across multiple insurance products, with cross-training in ticket protection.
- A collaborative culture that welcomes initiative and suggestions.

What you'll be doing

You'll work across claims and customer service, helping customers understand their options and keeping cases moving towards resolution.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Handling mobile phone and gadget claims involving loss, theft and accidental damage, including cover provided alongside travel insurance.
- Managing ticket protection claims and refund requests once cross-trained.
- Responding to travel, mobile phone and gadget insurance sales and service enquiries.
- Liaising with underwriters on travel-related product queries.
- Working with repair and fulfilment colleagues to progress and conclude claims.
- Processing premium and excess payments.
- Managing policy cancellations and retention conversations.
- Recording and handling first-line complaints in line with company procedures.
- Working with finance colleagues on payment and reconciliation queries.
- Supporting colleagues across the business and suggesting improvements to processes and customer service.

What we're looking for

Previous claims or customer service experience within a regulated insurance business is essential.

You'll be customer-focused, enthusiastic and keen to develop your insurance knowledge, with the confidence to take responsibility for a varied workload.

You'll also need:
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with confidence on the telephone and by email.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- A positive, hardworking and self-motivated approach.
- The ability to manage multiple products, tasks and priorities in a busy, evolving environment.
- A proactive mindset and willingness to ask questions and contribute ideas.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel.

Experience handling complaints, investigating potential fraud or working in additional languages would be beneficial, although these are not essential.

Location and working hours

This role is fully office-based in Shoeburyness, with close day-to-day collaboration between the manager and team. Hybrid working is not available.

Working hours are:
- Monday-Wednesday: 9:00am-5:30pm.
- Thursday-Friday: 9:00am-5:00pm.

An immediate start is available.

If you're looking for a varied insurance role where you can develop your knowledge and take ownership of the customer experience, apply with your CV or contact CKB Recruitment for a confidential conversation.

title: Claims & Customer Service Advisor
description:
Claims & Customer Service Advisor

Location: Shoeburyness, Essex
Salary: £26000 - £28000
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent, ONSITE

Overview

Are you looking for a varied insurance role where you can truly take ownership of customer outcomes?

I am seeking a Claims & Customer Service Advisor to join a dynamic team supporting a range of insurance products, including Gadget, Travel and Ticket Protection. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with insurance industry experience who enjoys working across claims, customer service, sales support and complaint handling, rather than being limited to a purely scripted contact centre role.

You'll work closely with underwriters, repair and fulfilment partners, finance teams, and other internal stakeholders to ensure customers receive excellent service and their cases are resolved efficiently.

Key Responsibilities

Claims Handling
- Manage mobile phone and gadget insurance claims, including loss, theft and accidental damage claims.
- Handle ticket protection claims and refund requests following product training.
- Liaise with underwriters regarding travel insurance product queries.
- Work closely with repair and fulfilment teams to progress and conclude claims efficiently.

Sales & Customer Service
- Respond to travel insurance sales and service enquiries.
- Support customers with mobile phone and gadget insurance queries.
- Process premium and excess payments.
- Manage policy cancellations and retention conversations.

Complaints Management
- Log and handle first-line customer complaints in line with company procedures and regulatory requirements.

Team Collaboration
- Work with Finance and Accounts teams to resolve payment and reconciliation queries.
- Liaise with colleagues and stakeholders across the business to support customer outcomes.
- Support the wider team with additional duties as required.

What I'm Looking For
- Previous experience within a regulated insurance environment, ideally in claims handling or customer service.
- Strong understanding of insurance products and processes.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills with confidence handling customer interactions via phone and email.
- High levels of accuracy and attention to detail.
- A positive, proactive and self-motivated approach.
- A genuine customer-first mindset with the ability to take ownership of cases from start to finish.
- Comfortable working across multiple products and priorities within a fast-paced environment.
- Strong IT skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel.
- A willingness to suggest improvements and contribute ideas to enhance customer experience and operational processes.

Desirable Skills
- Experience handling customer complaints.
- Knowledge of fraud investigation and fraud management processes.
- Additional language skills (bi-lingual or multi-lingual).

What's on Offer?
- A diverse and engaging role with exposure to multiple insurance products.
- The opportunity to build experience across claims, service, sales support and complaints handling.
- A collaborative team environment where your ideas and contributions are valued.
- The chance to make a real impact on customer outcomes through ownership and accountability.

If you're an insurance professional who enjoys variety, problem-solving and delivering outstanding customer service, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Service Desk Support Analyst
description:
Company Description

About FRP

At FRP, we are a leading national business advisory firm based in the UK. With over 850 team members, including more than 100 partners, we specialise in Corporate Finance, Debt Advisory, Forensic Services, Financial Advisory and Restructuring Advisory. Operating from 35 offices across the UK, Isle of Man and Cyprus, we are dedicated to helping clients navigate complex and difficult situations to create, preserve, and recover value.

Our approach is known for being honest, clear, and considered. We provide strategic solutions that cater to a broad range of businesses, from multinational organisations to small enterprises. Our commitment is to deliver expert advice and support, ensuring our clients can make informed decisions and achieve their goals.

Job Description

The Service Desk Analyst acts as the first point of contact for all IT-related incidents and service requests within FRP Advisory. This role is critical in ensuring smooth technology operations across a fast-paced professional services environment. You will deliver timely, effective resolutions and exceptional customer service to maintain high user satisfaction and support FRP's commitment to operational excellence.

Location: Flexible across FRP Advisory offices (Chelmsford, Brentwood, London, and other UK sites)

Reports To: Service Desk Manager

Key responsibilities:
- Serve as the initial contact for IT support via phone, email, or ticketing system.
- Log, categorize, and prioritize incidents and service requests using the ITSM platform.
- Diagnose and resolve technical issues related to hardware, software, and network connectivity.
- Escalate complex issues to second-line support or specialist teams, ensuring thorough documentation.
- Provide guidance and support for core business applications (e.g., Microsoft 365, collaboration tools, and FRP-specific systems).
- Maintain accurate records of all interactions and resolutions in line with compliance standards.
- Follow ITIL-aligned best practices for incident, problem, and request management.
- Assist in creating and maintaining knowledge base articles to support self-service and team efficiency.
- Ensure adherence to FRP's security policies and regulatory requirements.
- Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the Service Desk function.

Qualifications

Essential:
- Strong customer service and communication skills, with a professional and client-focused approach.
- Solid understanding of Windows OS, Microsoft 365, and common business applications.
- Ability to troubleshoot hardware and software issues effectively.
- Familiarity with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Remedy).

Desirable:
- ITIL Foundation certification.
- Previous experience in a Service Desk or IT support role within a professional services or financial environment.

Key Competencies
- Analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment.
- Collaborative team player with a proactive attitude.
- Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy.
- Flexibility and adaptability to changing business needs.

Working Hours

Coverage between 08:00 and 18:00, with staggered shifts to ensure early and late support as required.

Additional Information

Our Values
- Straightforward: We provide clear, no-nonsense advice
- Confident: Our guidance is backed by expertise and evidence
- Pragmatic: We focus on practical solutions and tangible outcomes
- Real: We are professional yet approachable, understanding the challenges our clients face

Our Commitment to You and the Environment

At FRP, sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on building and maintaining meaningful, long-term relationships with all our stakeholders - including our employees, clients, and local communities - while also reducing our impact on the natural environment.

We are always striving to improve in all areas - whether it's our people, our clients, our planet or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and diverse culture for our people. We maintain an Equal Opportunities Policy, ensuring that recruitment and employment decisions are based solely on the skills and experience required for our professional services - regardless of ethnicity, race, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We believe every individual should have the opportunity to thrive.

Our learning and development programmes enable us to invest in growing our employees' careers. We aim to empower our team members to each achieve their potential.

We are committed to growing long-term relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients' sustainability and success lead to our sustainability and success. We are emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.
